_meta.description: Literature metadata retrieved from a PubMed-backed research index (Firecrawl research search) on 2026-10-29. Only identifiers and titles are stored (abstract rights unclear => metadata + link only).
_meta.classificationNote: studyType, evidenceLevel, ingredient links and outcome links are AI-PROPOSED from titles only. They are stored with entryMode=AI_EXTRACTED and reviewStatus=SUBMITTED. None are reviewed. Full-text extraction (sample size, concentration, statistics) has NOT been done.
_meta.levels: 1 consumer self-report; 2 longitudinal observational; 3 standardized image/measurement signal; 4 professional observation; 5 controlled laboratory (in vitro / ex vivo / animal); 6 controlled human study; 7 independent replication
